title: CLO Skills Workshop - Applying Custom Display Settings
description: The CLO2025.0 version is officially launched! CLO technical experts will guide you step-by-step on how to save your custom display settings!
transcript:
Open the display settings in 2025.0
In the 2025.0 version, the display settings function has been added, so the software will not record the previous display option changes.
How to preserve the default display settings?
When we open the file, the 3D window will randomly display the texture surface, and display the basic line, internal line, thickness, and other information.
First, in the 3D window, change the texture surface to the thick texture surface display.
And hide the internal line and the basic line.
And hide the thickness, thinness.
In addition to the display settings in the 3D window, you can also change the display settings in the 2D window.
You can choose to display or hide clothing information, version information, etc.
For example, display or hide version name, logo.
You can also change the different clothing rendering types.
After the settings are complete, select the virtual model and delete the model.
Select all the panels and delete the panels.
Save this blank file.
After saving, select the settings in the software and define the user name.
Select default file, project, project file.
Change the default file to the file just saved.
The 3D window will prompt you to restart the program to change the application.
Restart the software to check the settings.
Open any clothing, and match a virtual model.
You can see that the display of this file is set to the settings just saved.
And press the Go button to start the program.
And now the program starts to load.
summary: ```markdown # CLO Skills Workshop - Applying Custom Display Settings ## Introduction In the 2025.0 version of the software, a new function has been added to manage display settings. This feature ensures that previous display option changes are no longer recorded by the software. ## Preserving Default Display Settings To preserve the default display settings, follow these steps: 1. **Open the 3D Window**: When you first open the file, the 3D window will randomly display the texture surface along with basic information such as line types, thickness, and internal lines. 2. **Change Texture Surface**: In the 3D window, switch the texture surface to the thick texture surface display. 3. **Hide Internal and Basic Lines**: Hide the internal line and basic line to clean up the visual presentation. 4. **Adjust Thickness**: Ensure that the thickness and thinness are hidden for clarity. ## Adjusting 2D Window Display Settings In addition to the 3D window, display settings can also be modified in the 2D window: - **Clothing Information**: You can choose to display or hide clothing information, including version information. - **Version Name and Logo**: Decide whether to show or hide the version name and logo. - **Clothing Rendering Types**: Change different clothing rendering types as per your requirements. ## Finalizing and Saving Settings Once you have configured the display settings: 1. **Select and Delete Models**: Select the virtual model and delete it. Also, select all panels and delete them. 2. **Save the Blank File**: Save this blank file to preserve your current settings. ## Setting User Preferences After saving, proceed to define your user preferences within the software: 1. **Access Settings**: Go to the settings menu. 2. **Define User Name**: Input your user name. 3. **Change Default File**: Select the default file, project, and project file settings. Change the default file to the blank file you just saved. 4. **Restart Prompt**: The 3D window will prompt you to restart the program to apply these changes. ## Verifying Settings To verify that your settings have been applied correctly: 1. **Restart the Software**: Restart the software to check the new configurations. 2. **Open a Clothing File**: Open any clothing file and match it with a virtual model. 3. **Check Display Settings**: You should see that the display of this file adheres to the settings you just saved. 4. **Start the Program**: Press the Go button to initiate the program. The program will begin to load with the new settings in place. ```
